_comment: Single source of truth for token-estimate assumptions shared by the frontend, data scripts and plan generator. Rationale and OSINT evidence: docs/TOKEN_ESTIMATE_VALIDATION.md.

agentTask._comment: OSINT band for one autonomous agent task: conservative = floor of the 200-800K input + 30-100K output band; midpoint = band center; optimistic = ceiling. Interactive CLI sessions measure 60-240K. See docs/TOKEN_ESTIMATE_VALIDATION.md.

_cacheWriteShare: Fraction of the cached context rewritten per turn (VULN-14: cold-prefix writes at the cache-write premium were never charged). 6% matches the empirical fresh-context share of the 20K-in agentic request being written to cache each turn.

timeOfDayBlend._comment: Time-of-day volume blend for providers with off-peak discounts (e.g. DeepSeek, Z.ai). Default 80% off-peak, 20% peak.

_sessionCacheModel: Multi-turn session cache model (WorkflowCalculator): of the tokens re-read within one session, this residual share re-pays full input price due to cache invalidations (tool outputs, file edits).
_providerCacheReadFallback: Documented cache-read ratios used ONLY when the upstream API omits cache prices (scripts/fetch-models.mjs). Keys are lowercase provider/id substrings.
